verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch12.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, comparisons, start years of each series)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,364 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; Uzbekistan's inflation series starts in 2011, Mozambique's in 2005, and remittances for Côte d'Ivoire and Cameroon end in 2024, all stated on the pages; an unsourced 'cocoa' description of Côte d'Ivoire and a misleading Madagascar ranking sentence were removed before publishing

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
